goals_amounts_check.name: goals_amounts_check
goals_amounts_check.value: "goals"."initial_amount" between 0 and 999999999999 and "goals"."monthly_deposit" between 0 and 999999999999 and "goals"."target_amount" between 1 and 999999999999

recurring_bills_installments_check.name: recurring_bills_installments_check
recurring_bills_installments_check.value: ("recurring_bills"."installments_total" is null and "recurring_bills"."installments_remaining" is null) or ("recurring_bills"."installments_total" between 1 and 600 and "recurring_bills"."installments_remaining" between 0 and "recurring_bills"."installments_total")
